$comment: Restore found different bytes than the checkpoint promised. The state a human sees: blocked, divergent, both hashes, and nothing merged. This is the fixture that keeps 'quarantine, never merge' from becoming a comment.

divergence.reason: the quarantined copy advanced two commits past its last checkpoint

action.note: the old copy is fenced out and cannot write after generation 4 is granted

expectedText: perms-1862 · blocked: divergent · PR 1862 · checkpoint 3m ago · expected journal b6f0a5c1, found 0c9d8e7f
assertions: both hashes are in the record and both appear in the human line, prefix or full
action.merged is false: a divergent restore never merges, never picks a side silently
the quarantine path and the new generation are recorded, so 'where did those commits go' has an answer
the exit code for the command that hit this is 1 (refusal), not 3 (infrastructure) — the tool worked
